items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Are there other outstanding baritone players in your band? I know you had Tommy Anastasis and Frank Hipner and people like that.

ctx.x: spirit in every direction, and that kind of player. He was heavily influenced by the early bop music, and he played baritone somewhat like Charlie Parker played alto. It was that --
Are there other outstanding baritone players in your band? I know you had Tommy Anastasis and Frank Hipner and people like that.
Yeah, Hipner was a very -- truly outstanding jazz player, but he was a kind of a strange young man, and he still resides, I think, in Reno.
